weighting: Each valid daily closing PE has equal weight. Median is calculated on all1211 daily values, not annual medians.
filters: 2021-11-03<=TRADE_DATE<=2026-11-03; PE_TTM positive and non-null; dates deduplicated. Latest supplied historical date is2026-11-02.
current_pe_method: Tencent quotedPE22.52 corroborated by2026-11-02 PE21.89600888 multiplied by1480/1439.1=22.51830529. Assumes latest trailing earnings denominator and share count remain unchanged. Current Nov3 point is shown separately and excluded from historical median, percentile sample and annual table.
percentile_definition: Share of1211 daily PE observations less than or equal to current price-scaled PE. This is an empirical valuation percentile, not a return probability.
notes: No forecast PE mixed with trailing PE.
No forward-adjusted closing prices used to reconstruct historical PE.
2021 and2026 annual rows cover partial years within the window.
Historical provider values may reflect its financial-report revision conventions; point-in-time backtesting was not performed.
